name: @mercatus-liber/adapter-mongodb
description: A real third reference persistence adapter (adapter-mongodb epic), backed by MongoDB -- implements @mercatus-liber/core's CatalogPersistenceAdapter interface with a genuinely different storage paradigm from adapter-sqlite/adapter-postgres (a document store, not a relational/SQL engine), proving the interface doesn't secretly assume rows-and-columns. Public surface is exactly CatalogPersistenceAdapter -- no MongoDB-specific type leaks out. Built against the official `mongodb` Node.js driver's real, current API (confirmed via research, not assumed -- MongoClient/db().collection()/findOne/find/updateOne with upsert). No live MongoDB account exists in this environment -- built and unit-tested for real correctness against a structurally-typed fake Db double (same honest-disclosure posture as adapter-shippo/adapter-printful/adapter-printify before their first live credential).
